title: HardwareDx: A Foundational Graph Model System for Datacenter Machine Repairs
abstract: arXiv:2611.23398v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid scale-up of AI infrastructure has made datacenter reliability a cornerstone of the cloud business economy. Since hardware failures in hyper-scale AI clusters can stall multi-million dollar training workloads, the downtime of individual machines can cause outsized economic losses. Minimizing machine downtime, therefore, is more important than ever.   To address this, we present Hardware Diagnoser (HardwareDx), an AI-driven hardware diagnosis system that applies a graph foundation model approach to automated datacenter maintenance. It allows a single model to diagnose many platforms and accelerate onboarding of new hardware products. Deployed at production scale at Google, HardwareDx yields substantial efficiency gains across diverse compute architectures. translated_title: HardwareDx：面向数据中心机器维修的基础图模型系统
translated_abstract: AI基础设施的快速扩张使得数据中心可靠性成为云业务经济的基石。由于超大规模AI集群中的硬件故障可能导致价值数百万美元的训练工作负载停滞，单台机器的停机时间会造成巨大的经济损失。因此，最大限度地减少机器停机时间比以往任何时候都更加重要。为解决这一问题，我们提出了硬件诊断器，这是一个AI驱动的硬件诊断系统，将图基础模型方法应用于自动化数据中心维护。它使单一模型能够诊断多种平台，并加速新硬件产品的接入。HardwareDx已在Google以生产规模部署，在多种计算架构上带来了显著的效率提升。真实环境评估表明，该系统在GPU平台上将生产停机时间降低了18.3%，在TPU上降低了16.1%。此外，它还显著加快了硬件部署速度。
tldr: HardwareDx是一种基于图基础模型的AI硬件诊断系统，已在Google生产环境部署，通过单一模型诊断多种平台，将GPU平台停机时间降低18.3%、TPU降低16.1%，并显著加速新硬件的接入与部署。
en_tdlr: HardwareDx is a graph foundation model-based AI hardware diagnosis system deployed at Google that enables a single model to diagnose diverse platforms, reducing production downtime by 18.3% on GPUs and 16.1% on TPUs while accelerating new hardware onboarding.
